title: Evening Tribune clipping: 'Jerome Teachers, Students Watch Strange Occurrence In The Sky'
description: Photocopied front-page clipping from The Evening Tribune, Marysville, Ohio (Vol. 8, No. 42) under the kicker "'Saucer' Experts Stumped". The article reports teachers Mrs. George Dittmar and Rodney Warrick and about 60 pupils at Jerome school seeing a cigar-shaped object and a falling 'angel's hair' substance. Handwritten annotations at top read "This account is correct" and "Yours truly, R. Warrick" with a date.
